sqlGroup.select: select a.id, a.tcode , a.dname , a.dcode , a.dval , a.defaultval from sys_dict a left join sys_dict_type b on a.tcode = b.dcode where b.dcode = #{value} and a.status = '1' and a.hidden = '0' order by a.defaultval desc, a.sort desc
select d.dval from sys_dict d left join sys_dict_type t on d.tcode = t.dcode where d.dcode = #{dicCode} and t.dcode = #{dicTypeCode}
select d.dname from sys_dict d left join sys_dict_type t on d.tcode = t.dcode where d.dval = '${dicVal}' and t.dcode = #{dicTypeCode}

select id, dname, dcode, sort, remark from sys_dict
and tcode = #{tcode}
and dname like concat('%', #{dname} , '%')
order by sort desc
select a.* from sys_dict a order by a.sort desc
select a.* from sys_dict a where a.pid =#{value} order by a.sort desc
select a.* from sys_dict a where a.pid ='-1' and a.tcode = #{tcode} order by a.sort desc

select a.tcode as tCode, b.dname as dictTypeName, a.dname as dictName, a.dcode as dCode, a.dval, if(a.`status`=1,"启用","禁用") as `status`, a.remark from sys_dict a left join sys_dict_type b on a.tcode = b.dcode order by a.sort desc
sqlGroup.update: update sys_dict set defaultval=false where tcode=#{tcode}
